start.text: A Keeper's lantern: iron, four panes of scraped horn, the ember in its ring punched through the cap. It hangs from the waymark's arm on a hook worn bright.
There is no wick in it. On a bed of pale ash inside sits one coal, no bigger than a fingernail, and it is the colour your hand is.
Ordinary flame barely troubles the Greying. This light pushes it back a stone's throw in every direction.
Your ember leans toward it. Very slightly, its coal leans back.
The road runs on north, straight and grey. The next lantern is off to the west, nowhere near the road.
